clue.text: Guide scholar boarding type of yacht

indicators.note: to board is to get on or into, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: the Dragon is a class of racing keelboat
MA, Master of Arts, is the crossword's usual scholar

explanation.surface: A learned passenger climbs aboard a particular kind of sailing boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Type of yacht' is the Dragon racing class. A dragoman was an interpreter and guide in the Ottoman Middle East.
explanation.definitionFit: A dragoman was an interpreter and guide for travellers in Arabic- or Turkish-speaking lands.

clue.text: Bar elevation of one given to prevarication

indicators.note: in a down clue, elevating a word lifts it so it reads from the bottom up

parts.note: someone who habitually prevaricates is a liar

explanation.surface: A bar raised for someone who habitually dodges the truth.
explanation.definitionFit: A rail is a horizontal bar, as on a fence or a towel holder.

clue.text: Courage shown by everyone in stand

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: a gantry is a frame or stand, for barrels or cranes
everyone means all

explanation.surface: Bravery displayed by the whole crowd in a grandstand.
explanation.definitionFit: Gallantry is bravery, especially in battle, so it is a synonym for courage.

clue.text: Optical illusion makes me show anger

parts.note: me, or mi, is the third note of the sol-fa scale
rage is fierce anger

explanation.surface: A trick of the light that leaves the speaker visibly furious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Makes' and 'show' are link words; the trick is reading 'me' as the musical note MI.
explanation.definitionFit: A mirage is an optical illusion caused by heat bending light, such as water seen in a desert.

clue.text: Not precisely top in common sense, not quite all there

indicators.note: something not precisely arranged is loose or inexact, so the letters of the phrase are rearranged

parts.note: the anagram fodder as the setter meant it: as printed it carries a second E that the answer does not use

explanation.surface: Someone lacking the best of ordinary good judgment is a bit dim.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not precisely' signals an anagram of TOP IN COMMON SENSE, but that phrase has two Es and the answer only one: the setter's fodder has a spare E.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin legal phrase means not of sound mind, colloquially someone not entirely sane.

clue.text: Somewhat rough cut pastry case

parts.note: to chop is to cut

indicators.note: a word's case is its outer shell, so take the first and last letters

explanation.surface: A slightly rough-cut pie crust.
explanation.definitionFit: Choppy describes water broken by small waves, that is, moderately rough.

clue.text: Crack conservationist cropping up in old exam

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: the CSE, Certificate of Secondary Education, was a British school exam replaced in 1988

indicators.note: in a down clue, coming up means the word reads bottom to top

parts.note: a saver conserves resources

explanation.surface: An ecologist's flaw surfaces in an old school test.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cropping up' reverses the conservationist in this down clue, and 'in' puts that reversal inside the old exam. The CSE was abolished in 1988.
explanation.definitionFit: A crevasse is a deep crack or fissure, especially in a glacier.

clue.text: Place for detention of convict

parts.note: taken as written
a lag is a convict, especially an old lag

explanation.surface: A prison where a convict is held.
explanation.definitionFit: An Oflag was a German prisoner-of-war camp for officers in the Second World War.

clue.text: Being widely admired shows ambivalence about rising higher

indicators.note: about means around, so one piece goes round the other

parts.note: polarity, having two opposed tendencies, stands for ambivalence

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means reading from the bottom up

parts.note: up means higher

explanation.surface: Fame brings mixed feelings about climbing further.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rising' reverses 'higher' in this down clue, and 'about' wraps the word for ambivalence round the result; 'shows' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Popularity is the state of being liked or admired by many people.

clue.text: Finer lager brewed in butts

indicators.note: brewing mixes and transforms ingredients, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A better beer made in barrels.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Butts' looks like beer casks, which suits the surface; it is the target mounds of a shooting range.
explanation.definitionFit: Butts are the earth mounds behind targets, and by extension a place for shooting practice.

clue.text: Before beginning of engagement, cut and run

indicators.note: before says the next piece goes ahead of the other in the answer

parts.note: to lop is to cut off

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Ahead of the start of a fight, one cuts and runs.
explanation.definitionFit: To lope is to run with a long, easy bounding stride.

clue.text: Silver is not well-behaved

definitions.meaning: silver ranks below the top metal, so it does not rate equal with the yellow one
said of a child who behaves perfectly

explanation.walkthrough: The first definition is cryptic: silver, coming second, is not equal in value to the top prize.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom is said of a child behaving perfectly, the second sense; literally it means equal in worth to the precious metal.

clue.text: Cheer pilot manoeuvring aircraft

indicators.note: manoeuvring means moving around, so the letters are shifted into a new order

explanation.surface: A pilot is cheered while performing aerial manoeuvres.
explanation.definitionFit: A helicopter is an aircraft lifted by rotating overhead blades.

clue.text: Port is red

definitions.meaning: port is the side of a vessel opposite starboard
red describes socialist or communist politics

explanation.definitionFit: Port is the nautical word for the left side; red describes the political left.

clue.text: This ensures admission, to join dance and play

parts.note: a pas is a step or dance in ballet
sport means play or fun

explanation.surface: A ticket to get in, joining dancing and games.
explanation.definitionFit: A passport is the document that secures entry to a foreign country.

clue.text: Put sweet lines down on paper, a fantasy

parts.note: to pipe icing is to squeeze sweet lines onto a cake
a ream is a quantity of paper, 500 sheets

explanation.surface: Writing sweet verses on paper is only a daydream.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On' in a down clue puts PIPED above REAM; 'sweet lines' looks like poetry but is icing.
explanation.definitionFit: A pipe dream is an unrealistic hope or fantasy, originally the visions of an opium smoker.

clue.text: Mythical king's diminutive relative, terribly pushy

parts.note: sis is a shortened form of sister

indicators.note: done terribly, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A legendary ruler's little sister is dreadfully pushy.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of 'king's' stands for 'is', a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Sisyphus was a king of Corinth in Greek myth, doomed to roll a boulder uphill for ever.

clue.text: Depression and melancholy ultimately evoke compassion

parts.note: a pit is a hollow or depression in the ground

indicators.note: ultimately means at the end, so take the final letter

explanation.surface: Low spirits and sadness arouse sympathy in the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Pity is the feeling of sorrow and compassion for another's suffering.

clue.text: Used in class, odd Scots pen

indicators.note: put to use inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: CL is an abbreviation for class
orra is a Scots word for odd or occasional

explanation.surface: A peculiar Scottish writing instrument used in the classroom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pen' is an enclosure for animals, not a writing tool.
explanation.definitionFit: A corral is an enclosure for livestock, a pen.

clue.text: To be strictly accurate, keep to present line

parts.note: a keep is the stronghold of a castle, a fort
present means here
a cord is a line or string

explanation.surface: Stick to the current policy, to be precise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Keep' and 'present' look like verbs but are nouns and an adjective; 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: For the record introduces a statement made so that the facts are stated correctly.

clue.text: Country, one partly responsible for attempted deception

indicators.note: partly responsible for says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A nation in part to blame for a hoax.
explanation.definitionFit: A try-on is an attempt to deceive or see what one can get away with.

clue.text: Still, by the end of the day, reading poetry

definitions.meaning: still in the sense of yet more

definitions.text: the end of the day, reading poetry
definitions.meaning: in verse, an old word for dusk or the close of day

explanation.definitionFit: Even means still, as in even better; in poetry even is evening.

clue.text: Visit guy

definitions.meaning: a visit is a brief period spent somewhere as a guest
a guy is a rope that holds something in place

explanation.definitionFit: A stay is a period of visiting; a stay is also a supporting rope like a guy.

clue.text: I never let a casual put in blank pages

indicators.note: something casual is careless and unordered, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: I never let someone casual pad a book with empty pages.
explanation.definitionFit: To interleave a book is to bind blank leaves between its printed ones.

clue.text: Girl clasping right tool

indicators.note: clasping means holding, so one piece goes around the other

parts.note: a wench is an old word for a girl

explanation.surface: A girl holds the correct implement.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrench is a tool for gripping and turning nuts and bolts, a spanner.

clue.text: Source of flavouring —- mint — reduced during special offer

indicators.note: during means within, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a sale is a time of special offers

indicators.note: reduced in the sense of broken down, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.walkthrough: 'Reduced' looks like a price cut but is the anagram signal, in the sense of broken down; 'during' puts the rearranged herb inside the special offer.
